reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text: I use the serum and finds it good therefore I brought this cream. The cream is super lightweight and absorbs fast.
reviews.zh: 用緊佢哋支精華覺得好用所以先買埋呢支cream。呢支cream超輕盈，吸收得好快。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text:
このクリームを使うと肌荒れを予防できて、既にできてしまったニキビも次の日には小さくなります！
テクスチャーもしっとりしていて感想も気にならずとてもお気に入りです¨̮⃝
reviews.zh:
用咗呢支cream之後可以預防皮膚敏感，連已經出咗嘅暗瘡第二日都會細返！
質地都好潤，搽完唔覺乾，超鍾意¨̮⃝

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text: The texture is light and absorb quickly.

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text: This product really helped lighten my dark spots and made my skin look brighter.
reviews.zh: 呢支產品真係幫到我淡咗啲斑，膚色都睇落光亮咗。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text: Love this one but … it was more irritating around my nose so need to figure out how to combine it with other skin care to keep using it.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢支……不過搽喺鼻嘅附近會比較刺激，所以要諗下點樣配搭其他護膚品先用得落。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text: Second time using this, still love it, the smell very refreshing and the cream hydrate, I’m not sure about whitening yet but it’s a good product to try
reviews.zh: 第二次用，依然好鍾意，氣味好清新，cream都好保濕，美白方面暫時未見到明顯效果，但係值得一試嘅產品。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text: The cream is great if you're okay with inconsistent capsules. Most of my capsules were stuck at the bottom and so I wasn't really getting any capsules for most of my time using this cream.
reviews.zh: 如果你接受到啲capsule每次份量都唔穩定嘅話，呢支cream係唔錯嘅。我用緊期間大部分capsule都黐咗喺底，所以我用咗好耐都冇乜點capsule用到。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Cream α 75ml Set (+25ml)
reviews.text:
使い心地が、めちゃくちゃ好きで何度目か分からないぐらいのリピです。
本当にオススメの商品です。
reviews.zh:
用落個感覺真係超級正，已經唔知loop咗幾多次。
真心推薦嘅產品。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
